<thought>To obtain a realistic retrosynthetic route I will look for a template that forms a carboxylic ester from a carboxylic acid and an alcohol (the reverse of ester hydrolysis). This template should match the target molecule and give two precursors: the poly‑unsaturated carboxylic acid fragment and the cyclohexanol fragment. I will search the template catalog for a transformation that breaks a “carboxylic acid” and an “aliphatic hydroxyl” to form a “carboxylic ester”.</thought>
